health-feature.quote: Содержит жирные кислоты Омега 3 и Омега 6, которые обеспечивают шелковистую и блестящую шерсть

texts.about_this_item: Gav! balanced complete dry food for adult dogs, meat assortment. Contains all the nutrients a dog needs for a full life. Omega 3 and Omega 6 fatty acids for a silky, shiny coat; supports strong immunity and efficient metabolism; calorie content matched to a dog's energy needs; vitamin and mineral complex. Made in Ukraine by Kormotech.
texts.ingredient_information: Composition: cereals, plant-derived products, meat and animal-derived products (5% chicken, 4% beef), oils and fats, minerals, yeast. Technological additives: antioxidants, preservatives. Sensory additives: colourants. Guaranteed analysis: protein 16.5%, fat 9.0%, ash 6.0%, fibre 3.0%, Omega 6 5.8%, calcium 1.0%, phosphorus 0.8%; 343 kcal/100 g.
texts.feeding_instructions: Daily amount by dog weight: 5 kg 104-107 g, 10 kg 176-180 g, 15 kg 238-244 g, 20 kg 296-303 g, 25 kg 349-359 g, 30 kg 401-411 g, 35 kg 450-461 g, 40 kg 497-510 g, 45 kg 543-557 g, 50 kg 588-603 g, 60 kg 674-691 g, 70 kg 756-776 g. Always provide fresh drinking water.
